title: What If You Fell Into the Sun?

scenes.text: What if you fell into the Sun? The fall isn't what gets you.
Drop anything at Earth's distance and it needs about 65 days to reach the Sun. You'd never last that long.
Long before the surface, you'd vaporize. The surface is 5,500 degrees Celsius, and the atmosphere above it is hotter, up to 2 million.
There's also nothing to land on. The Sun is a ball of plasma, getting hotter and denser with every mile.
At the center it's 15 million degrees, hot enough to fuse hydrogen into helium.
And the light you'd see? Energy from the core takes about 170,000 years to climb out, then 8 minutes more to reach us.
